scope: Complete paired games only. Top-level paid plays with ordinary draw/pick or missing scan-class effects, matched by player/round/raw turn and actual instance payment. Resource totals cover main-paced steps after payment within that entry, including other effects, company/task rewards and embedded income. Separate quick actions excluded. Known card instances tracked to first recorded subsequent use; unknown_removal and no_recorded_use are explicitly unresolved, not assumed wasted or ending hand. Card reuse may have later changes. Data/score causality is not attributed to a particular printed effect. All totals are descriptive transaction accounting, not marginal return or causal mechanism proof.
